ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: I picked Plover because this query is a straightforward creative-writing and formatting task with no harm-adjacent content, so the deciding factors are raw capability on creative generation and instruction-following. Plover leads Whimbrel on both relevant internal evals (Creative Generation 84.7 vs 78.8) and public benchmarks (IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4), and these gaps exceed the 2.0-point variance threshold. Whimbrel's only distinguishing trait—reduced aversion to distasteful-but-permissible material—offers no advantage here since the content is benign. So Plover was the clear choice on capability grounds.
